title: Gluten-Free Sausage Wrap
description: A simple and quick meal made with sausage, melted cheese, and a delicious Syrian wrap.

ingredients.name: Sausage
ingredients.notes: Cooked to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C)

ingredients.name: Optional toppings
ingredients.notes: Chopped onions, bell peppers, or olives

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook the sausage for about 5-7 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Slice the cooked sausage into pieces.
Warm the Syrian wrap in a dry pan or in the microwave.
Add the sliced sausage and melted cheese to the wrap.
Add any desired toppings, such as chopped onions or bell peppers.
Fold the wrap to enclose the filling.
